## Summary

Stilbene as a mixture of its two isomers by Wittig olefination of
benzaldehyde, with both isomers isolated. This fixture has two products.

## Reagents

| Reagent | CAS | MW (g/mol) | Amount | mmol | Equiv |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Benzaldehyde | 100-52-7 | 106.12 | 1.06 g | 10.0 | 1.0 |
| Benzyltriphenylphosphonium chloride | 1100-88-5 | 388.87 | 4.08 g | 10.5 | 1.05 |

## Procedure

1. Suspend the phosphonium salt in dry solvent.
2. Add the base, then the benzaldehyde, and stir for 2 h.

## Workup and Purification

Filter off the solid and concentrate the filtrate.

## Characterization

Colourless solid.

## Notes

1. Fictitious procedure.

## Hazards and Waste Disposal

Collect organic waste separately.

None.
